S10 follow-up, two measured failures (real Chromium, Playwright 1.64):
1. Loading /command-center/project/<id> directly shows 'Could not start the Command Center. Required scripts failed to load.' because tools/watch-assets/command-center-boot.js loads 'assets/command-center-data.js' and 'assets/hive-panels.js' with relative URLs (404 under /command-center/project/). In tests/browser/browser-cleanup.mjs make trackBrowser accept either a BrowserServer (use server.process().pid) or an object {server, browser}; keep descendantPids, closeBrowserFully and every safety rule (never kill pid 0/1/negatives or pids outside the tracked tree, SIGTERM then SIGKILL on the group, safe twice) unchanged. In tests/browser/command-center.smoke.mjs launch with const server = await chromium.launchServer({ headless: true }); const browser = await chromium.connect(server.wsEndpoint()); track the server's pid, and on cleanup close the browser connection, then server.close(), then closeBrowserFully for leftover processes. Keep the Chromium-missing hint. Update tests/browser-cleanup.test.mjs for the new trackBrowser input shapes (a fake server with process() returning {pid}, and the {server, browser} form; a plain object without process() still throws a clear error). Do not add page patches or polyfills to the smoke test.
